argv: Hide a kind of place from its card

ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a phone, from a place's card's More on a walk, tap "What I’m into ›". **Expect:** the sheet is gone, What I'm into opens with Monuments and memorials (the card's kind) just under its pinned History heading, Back reads "‹ Walk" (Android: the route's own arrow, "Walk, back"), and Back returns to the walk with the map as it was (HK6)

- [ ] **Do:** on an iPhone and an Android phone, on a walk with Places on, tap a place you have not found, then More (…) at its card's top right; turn its subtype off, then its kind, then both back on; close the sheet by Done, by a tap on the dimmed map and (Android) by Back. **Expect:** the sheet "Show on the map" rises over the walk's map with the card under it, the pins of the switched kind leave the map behind at once and come back, the subtype's row dims while its kind is off, each close leaves the card, and nothing is left over the map; VoiceOver and TalkBack read "More, button" and each row as a switch with "Part of …" on the subtype (HK1-HK3, HK7)
